letter.subject: Open application | Junior software developer
paragraphs: I am applying for a junior software development role. My personal projects focus on API checks, document review and web applications. I am looking for a team where I can work on scoped development tasks with code review and practical feedback.

API Contract Guard compares a defined subset of OpenAPI contracts. I defined its supported checks and expected reports, then reviewed the AI-assisted implementation and test cases. These personal projects give us concrete examples to discuss, including the assistance used and the limits of each result.

I use coding assistants for implementation and continue to develop programming independence. I would be glad to walk through a project, explain its decisions and work through a suitable technical exercise. My earlier retail work and volunteer tutoring also gave me experience coordinating tasks and explaining unfamiliar topics.

I am based in Brussels and looking for full-time remote work from Belgium. My online BSc (Hons) Computer Science at OPIT began in September 2026, and I plan to study alongside work. My English is certified at EF SET C2 overall (77/100). I can discuss the working hours and support needed for a first role.
